SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

GO

ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_DimUserAccess] AS BEGIN

			
WITH USERACCESS_SK
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(UserAccessSK),0) RN FROM DW.DimUserAccess

)
,
TEMP_DW_DimUserAccess
AS (
SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM USERACCESS_SK) AS UserAccessSK
, * from ( 
		SELECT DISTINCT
		 BUM.UserID AS UserID
		,BUM.UserName AS UserName
		,BUM.UserRole AS UserRole
		,BUM.UserEmail AS UserEmail
		,DBR.BranchSK AS BranchSK
		,BUM.BranchID AS BranchID
		,NULL AS PCCSK
		,BUM.ProfitCostCode AS PCCCode
		,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
		,BUM.BankID AS BankID
		,1 AS CurrentIndicator
		,Getdate() AS ValidStartDate
        ,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
		,BUM.SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,Getdate() AS InsertDttm
		FROM BNKM.UserAccessMatrix BUM
		LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DBR ON BUM.BranchId = DBR.BranchId
		LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BUM.BankId = DDB.BankId
		WHERE BUM.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31'
        ) A
)

--SELECT * FROM TEMP_DW_DimUserAccess;


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DimUserAccess FROM TEMP_DW_DimUserAccess;

WITH
TEMP_DW_DimUserAccess_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,UserAccessSK),
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,UserID)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,UserName)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,UserRole)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,UserEmail)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BranchSK)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BranchID)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PCCSK)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PCCCode)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BankSK)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BankID)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SourceSystemCode)
    )
    ) HASHROW, UserID, UserName, UserRole, UserEmail, BranchID, PCCCode, BankID 
    FROM #TEMP_DW_DimUserAccess
)
,
TEMP_DW_DimUserAccess_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,UserAccessSK),
    CONVERT(VARCHAR,UserID)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,UserName)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,UserRole)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,UserEmail)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BranchSK)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BranchID)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PCCSK)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PCCCode)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BankSK)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,BankID)
	,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SourceSystemCode)
    )
    ) HASHROW, UserID, UserName, UserRole, UserEmail, BranchID, PCCCode, BankID 
    FROM DW.DimUserAccess  WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1
)
,
TEMP_DW_DimUserAccess_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.UserID,TGT.UserID) AS UserID
	,ISNULL(SRC.UserName,TGT.UserName) AS UserName
	,ISNULL(SRC.UserRole,TGT.UserRole) AS UserRole
	,ISNULL(SRC.UserEmail,TGT.UserEmail) AS UserEmail
	,ISNULL(SRC.BranchID,TGT.BranchID) AS BranchID
	,ISNULL(SRC.PCCCode,TGT.PCCCode) AS PCCCode
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankID,TGT.BankID) AS BankID
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.UserID IS NULL AND TGT.UserName IS NULL
		AND TGT.UserRole IS NULL AND TGT.UserEmail IS NULL 
		AND TGT.BranchID IS NULL AND TGT.PCCCode IS NULL 
		AND TGT.BankID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL 
		END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DW_DimUserAccess_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_DW_DimUserAccess_TGT	TGT
ON	coalesce(SRC.UserID,'') 	= 	coalesce(TGT.UserID,'')
AND coalesce(SRC.UserName,'') 	= 	coalesce(TGT.UserName,'')
AND coalesce(SRC.UserRole,'') 	= 	coalesce(TGT.UserRole,'')
AND coalesce(SRC.UserEmail,'') 	= 	coalesce(TGT.UserEmail,'')
AND coalesce(SRC.BranchID,'') 	= 	coalesce(TGT.BranchID,'')
AND coalesce(SRC.PCCCode,'') 	= 	coalesce(TGT.PCCCode,'')
AND coalesce(SRC.BankID,'') 	= 	coalesce(TGT.BankID,'')
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW --OR (TGT.UserID IS NULL AND TGT.UserName IS NULL AND TGT.UserRole IS NULL AND TGT.UserEmail IS NULL AND TGT.BranchID IS NULL AND TGT.PCCCode IS NULL AND TGT.BankID IS NULL) 
OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
--SELECT *  FROM TEMP_DW_DimUserAccess_DELTA;

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DW_DimUserAccess_DELTA FROM TEMP_DW_DimUserAccess_DELTA;



--------UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
    ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
    ,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimUserAccess TGT
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimUserAccess_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.UserID = TGT.UserID  AND DELTA.UserName = TGT.UserName AND DELTA.UserRole = TGT.UserRole AND DELTA.UserEmail = TGT.UserEmail AND DELTA.BranchID = TGT.BranchID AND DELTA.PCCCode = TGT.PCCCode AND DELTA.BankID = TGT.BankID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimUserAccess SRC ON SRC.UserID = TGT.UserID AND SRC.UserName = TGT.UserName AND SRC.UserRole = TGT.UserRole AND SRC.UserEmail = TGT.UserEmail AND SRC.BranchID = TGT.BranchID AND SRC.PCCCode = TGT.PCCCode AND SRC.BankID = TGT.BankID
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1;


INSERT INTO DW.DimUserAccess (
	UserAccessSK
	,UserID
	,UserName
	,UserRole
	,UserEmail
	,BranchSK
	,BranchID
	,PCCSK
	,PCCCode
	,BankSK
	,BankID
	,CurrentIndicator
	,ValidStartDate
	,ValidEndDate
	,SourceSystemCode
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm)
SELECT
	UserAccessSK
	,SRC.UserID
	,SRC.UserName
	,SRC.UserRole
	,SRC.UserEmail
	,BranchSK
	,SRC.BranchID
	,PCCSK
	,SRC.PCCCode
	,BankSK
	,SRC.BankID
	,CurrentIndicator
	,ValidStartDate
	,ValidEndDate
	,SourceSystemCode
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_DW_DimUserAccess SRC
JOIN #TEMP_DW_DimUserAccess_DELTA DELTA 
--ON DELTA.CustomerSK = SRC.CustomerSK  AND DELTA.CustomerID = SRC.CustomerID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');
ON  DELTA.UserID     = SRC.UserID  
AND DELTA.UserName   = SRC.UserName
AND DELTA.UserRole   = SRC.UserRole 
AND DELTA.UserEmail  = SRC.UserEmail 
AND DELTA.BranchID   = SRC.BranchID 
AND DELTA.PCCCode    = SRC.PCCCode 
AND DELTA.BankID     = SRC.BankID
AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

END
GO
